title: Length, Weight & Capacity
description: Class 3 IMO — Length (cm, m, km), weight (g, kg) and capacity (ml, L): standard units, conversions, addition and subtraction in the same unit, and word problems.

topics.title: Length: cm, m, km
topics.concept:
Length is measured in centimetres (cm), metres (m) and kilometres (km). Short things are in cm, room-sized lengths in m, and long distances in km.

The key conversions are 1 m = 100 cm and 1 km = 1000 m. To change m to cm, multiply by 100; to change km to m, multiply by 1000.
recap: Use cm for small lengths, m for rooms, km for distances.

topics.title: Weight (g, kg) & Capacity (ml, L)
topics.concept:
Weight is measured in grams (g) and kilograms (kg), with 1 kg = 1000 g. Capacity (how much liquid a container holds) is measured in millilitres (ml) and litres (L), with 1 L = 1000 ml.

To change kg to g or L to ml, multiply by 1000; to go the other way, divide by 1000.
recap: Bigger unit to smaller: multiply by 1000.

topics.title: Adding, Subtracting & Word Problems
topics.concept:
We can add or subtract measurements when they are in the same unit. For example, 250 ml + 350 ml = 600 ml, and 5 kg − 2 kg = 3 kg.

In word problems, words like in all and total mean add, while left and how much more mean subtract.

examples.solution: Add metres and cm separately: 6 m 80 cm.

examples.problem: A bottle holds 1 L. You drink 250 ml. How much is left?

recap: Add or subtract only when units are the same.
Convert first if the units are different.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three measure length)?
questions.explanation: kg measures weight; the others measure length.

questions.q: Which is longer, 1 km or 900 m?
questions.explanation: 1 km = 1000 m, which is more than 900 m.
